name: Anna Lindqvist
title: Lead Business Analyst
summary: Senior business analysis leader with experience driving large-scale digital transformation, process optimization, and cross-functional delivery in regulated and customer-facing environments. Known for translating business strategy into actionable requirements, improving operating models, and aligning stakeholders across product, technology, and operations.

bullets: Led a team of 6 analysts supporting a banking platform modernization program across lending, onboarding, and customer servicing.
Defined and prioritized over 180 business requirements, reducing rework during development by 32%.
Facilitated workshops with 40+ stakeholders across risk, compliance, and technology to align scope and delivery milestones.
Improved release readiness by introducing traceability and sign-off controls, cutting approval delays by 25%.
Owned analysis for a customer experience initiative affecting 1.2 million mobile and broadband users in Sweden.
Mapped end-to-end service journeys and identified process bottlenecks that reduced case handling time by 18%.
Worked closely with product owners and architects to refine backlog items and support quarterly planning for 4 agile teams.
Built KPI reporting in Power BI to track adoption, churn, and service performance across key markets.
Supported global operations and sales process improvements across 12 countries, standardizing core reporting and approval workflows.
Gathered and documented functional requirements for CRM and internal order management enhancements.
Coordinated UAT for multiple releases, helping achieve a 96% first-pass acceptance rate.
Partnered with change managers to prepare training materials and improve end-user adoption after deployment.
Assisted with requirements documentation and process analysis for retail banking operations.
Prepared dashboards and management summaries used by senior leaders in monthly performance reviews.
Supported data cleanup and validation activities that improved reporting accuracy by 20%.
